2069 // shots, the jitter grows with the angle job's difficulty: ANGLE_JITTER
2070 // x (1 - share + share x difficulty) x (1 - Heading x SKILL_REDUCTION),
2071 // a standard deviation, set so the drill's mean miss comes out at
2072 // those figures; the hardest header is about 2.4 times the easiest.
2073 // All of it sideways; the elevation has its own (a placeholder: 5 deg
2074 // at 1 to 0.1 at 99).
